lead.title: Google Ads API moves to two releases per month
lead.deck: From v26, Google doubles release cadence; four major releases/year and sunset schedules stay unchanged.

note: What's Actually New: Google API cadence and Meta models are confirmed; Microsoft AI Max messaging guidance remains a closed-pilot report.

stories.title: Google Ads API: two releases per month
stories.summary: WHAT: Two monthly releases from v26; four major releases/year and sunsets unchanged. Confirmed.
stories.why: New features may reach reporting tools sooner.
stories.use_case: Track release notes and test updates.

stories.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder models
stories.summary: WHAT: Muse Wonder is available via Meta Model API and Muse Code; Wonder Full is for Muse Code subscribers. Confirmed.
stories.why: A new option for multi-step marketing assistants.
stories.use_case: Test read-only reporting on approved exports.

stories.title: Merchant Center low-quality image products can still show
stories.summary: WHAT: Google Help says flagged products remain in ads/free listings; 500×500 minimum enforcement starts 31 Jan 2027. Confirmed.
stories.why: Poor images can still reduce engagement.
stories.use_case: Audit flagged SKUs and improve images before Jan 2027.
